meta.notes: guidance_scale=1.0 => single (conditional) forward per step; attention equals the cond pass at any CFG scale. The released checkpoints ship is_amplify_history=False, so the history-amplification mechanism is INACTIVE ('mass' = the model's natural attention). 'mass_amplified' is a COUNTERFACTUAL: history keys scaled x1.0 to illustrate how the mechanism would redistribute mass (amplify_simulated=true).
